## How does the Wellina marketplace work?

Choose your plan or shop individual meals, customize your menu from 100+ options, and we’ll deliver
portion-controlled, dietitian-designed meals to your door. Just heat, eat, and enjoy—no cooking or
meal prep required.

## What’s the difference between structured plans and a la carte?

specific nutrition goals. A la carte lets you shop individual meals and snacks—perfect for
supplementing your own cooking.

## Are the meals suitable for specific dietary needs?

All meals are portion-controlled and designed by registered dietitians. Each meal shows detailed
nutrition info including calories, protein, carbs, and fat.

## How much does Wellina cost?

Options start at just $1.99 per meal with no hidden fees. Pricing varies based on our plan and
number of meals.

### [Medical Guardian | Medical Alert Systems][126]

Medical Devices

As a trusted leader in personal safety and medical alert systems, Medical Guardian has been
empowering seniors and their families for over two decades. With a mission to provide safety,
security, and peace of mind, Medical Guardian offers state-of-the-art solutions that enable seniors
to maintain independence while staying connected to immediate help whenever needed.Who We AreFounded
on the belief that everyone deserves to feel safe at home and on the go, Medical Guardian has grown
into one of the most recognized names in the personal emergency response industry. With a focus on
innovation, accessibility, and reliability, we are committed to delivering products and services
that enhance the quality of life for seniors nationwide.Our Solutions: Tailored for Every
LifestyleMedical Guardian understands that no two lifestyles are the same, which is why we provide a
wide range of medical alert systems to meet unique needs. From home-based devices to on-the-go
wearable technology, our solutions are designed to fit seamlessly into daily life. Key offerings
include:In-Home Medical Alert SystemsPerfect for seniors who spend most of their time at home, these
systems provide 24/7 monitoring through easy-to-use base stations and wearable help buttons. With
features like fall detection and two-way communication, help is always just a button press
away.Mobile Medical Alert SystemsFor active seniors, our mobile systems offer GPS tracking and
nationwide coverage, ensuring safety wherever life takes you. These portable devices are lightweight
and discreet, providing peace of mind without compromising mobility.Wearable TechnologyCombining
functionality with style, our wearable devices include medical alert watches and pendants equipped
with cutting-edge technology. These devices are not only lifesaving tools but also fashionable
accessories that integrate seamlessly into any wardrobe.Fall Detection TechnologyFalls are one of
the leading causes of injury among seniors. Medical Guardian’s advanced fall detection sensors can
automatically alert our monitoring center in case of a fall, even if the user is unable to press the
button.Caregiver ToolsMedical Guardian’s products are complemented by innovative caregiver tools,
such as activity tracking and location monitoring, to keep loved ones informed and reassured.PERS
Solutions for Senior Living CommunitiesMed

### [Medical Guardian | Medical Alert Systems][126]

Medical Devices

As a trusted leader in personal safety and medical alert systems, Medical Guardian has been
empowering seniors and their families for over two decades. With a mission to provide safety,
security, and peace of mind, Medical Guardian offers state-of-the-art solutions that enable seniors
to maintain independence while staying connected to immediate help whenever needed.Who We AreFounded
on the belief that everyone deserves to feel safe at home and on the go, Medical Guardian has grown
into one of the most recognized names in the personal emergency response industry. With a focus on
innovation, accessibility, and reliability, we are committed to delivering products and services
that enhance the quality of life for seniors nationwide.Our Solutions: Tailored for Every
LifestyleMedical Guardian understands that no two lifestyles are the same, which is why we provide a
wide range of medical alert systems to meet unique needs. From home-based devices to on-the-go
wearable technology, our solutions are designed to fit seamlessly into daily life. Key offerings
include:In-Home Medical Alert SystemsPerfect for seniors who spend most of their time at home, these
systems provide 24/7 monitoring through easy-to-use base stations and wearable help buttons. With
features like fall detection and two-way communication, help is always just a button press
away.Mobile Medical Alert SystemsFor active seniors, our mobile systems offer GPS tracking and
nationwide coverage, ensuring safety wherever life takes you. These portable devices are lightweight
and discreet, providing peace of mind without compromising mobility.Wearable TechnologyCombining
functionality with style, our wearable devices include medical alert watches and pendants equipped
with cutting-edge technology. These devices are not only lifesaving tools but also fashionable
accessories that integrate seamlessly into any wardrobe.Fall Detection TechnologyFalls are one of
the leading causes of injury among seniors. Medical Guardian’s advanced fall detection sensors can
automatically alert our monitoring center in case of a fall, even if the user is unable to press the
button.Caregiver ToolsMedical Guardian’s products are complemented by innovative caregiver tools,
such as activity tracking and location monitoring, to keep loved ones informed and reassured.PERS

For a more efficiently-fed planet. Responsible harvesting, low-carbon processing, and validated

###### Why us?

## Science-backed marine mineral solutions for livestock health and productivity.

### Proven, science-backed products

Performance supported by extensive academic and on farm research.

### Premium natural ingredients

Targeted, species-specific solutions for animal health and welfare.

### Partnering for a Sustainable Future

Improving efficiency, reducing emissions, and supporting regenerative agriculture.

Our natural, marine-derived products are backed by research to support livestock health and optimise
productivity. Each one is designed to help animals stay healthier and perform better. Using our own
technologies, we develop targeted solutions using postbiotics, non-living calcified Lithothamnion
sp., and bioactives from brown seaweed that meet real market needs. Behind it all is the research
and expertise of the Marigot Research Centre.

mineral-based animal nutrition solutions. Harnessing the natural power of seaweed, we are dedicated

# Science-backed nutrition tracking at your fingertips.

From macros to micros, Cronometer gives you personalized insight into your diet, exercise, and
health data so you can make more informed decisions about your health.

[ Sign Up For Free ][28]
[ Download The App ][29]
[A card explaining the benefits of using the Cronometer app. Log food.]
[A card explaining the benefits of using the Cronometer app. Develop healthy habits.]
[A card explaining the benefits of using the Cronometer app. Connect with devices.]

#### As seen in

## Why use Cronometer?

Our lab-analyzed nutrition data will help you:

## Dial up your diet

See which of the essential vitamins and minerals you’re getting the most and least of, helping you
eat a more balanced diet. Track up to 95 different nutrients and compounds.

## Reach & maintain your goal weight

Monitor your food intake with detailed food journaling, verified nutrition information, and a
built-in nutritional target wizard to keep yourself accountable.

## Get a holistic view of your health

Sync Cronometer with all your devices and track all your biometrics from pain symptoms to gut health
to blood sugar levels and more.

## Gain a trustworthy companion

We're proud to offer accurate nutrition information within a lock-tight framework to keep your data
safe. We encrypt all data, uphold industry best practices, and enforce strict access controls.

## Syncs with all your favorite devices—on your wrist, finger, or phone

You’ll love how easily data flows between Cronometer and partner apps and devices.

[ View Integrations ][30]

## Four easy ways to log your meals.

Dive deeper into your nutrition with four quick and easy ways to track.

### Snap a photo

Easily log meals with our AI Photo Logging feature.

### Voice control

Simply speak to us or Siri to log your food.

### Start typing

Use our classic text search to find food.

### Scan it

Scan the barcode of any product - for free!

[A woman is doing a yoga pose in front of a rainbow.]

# Elderly Companion Services

**Elderly Companion Services: A Comprehensive Analysis**

**Introduction**

In a world where the population is aging at an unprecedented rate, the need for services that
support the elderly has become increasingly significant. Elderly Companion Services stand at the
forefront of this demand, offering a blend of companionship and assistance to enhance the quality of
life for seniors. This article delves into the multifaceted nature of these services, exploring
their impact, economic considerations, technological advancements, and the challenges they face. By
the end of this exploration, readers will have a nuanced understanding of Elderly Companion Services
and their pivotal role in society.

**Understanding Elderly Companion Services**

Elderly Companion Services are designed to provide companionship, emotional support, and various
forms of assistance to elderly individuals who may live alone or require aid due to physical or
cognitive limitations. These services range from daily activities like meal preparation and
medication management to providing a friendly presence that can reduce feelings of isolation and
loneliness. The core components of these services include:
* **Personal Care Assistance**: Help with bathing, dressing, toileting, and other personal care
  tasks.
* **Social Engagement**: Facilitating interactions with others to prevent social isolation.
* **Health Monitoring**: Keeping an eye on the client’s health and alerting family or medical
  professionals if necessary.
* **Homemaking Services**: Assisting with household chores such as cleaning, laundry, and meal
  preparation.

The historical context of Elderly Companion Services shows a gradual evolution from informal care
provided by family members to a more structured and professionalized service sector. As society
grapples with the realities of an aging population, these services have become an integral part of
the continuum of eldercare.

**Global Impact and Trends**

The impact of Elderly Companion Services is not confined to any single region but is a global
concern. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), the proportion of the world’s population
over 60 years will double from 12% in 2015 to 22% in 2050. This demographic shift has led to a rise
in demand for companion services worldwide, with varying responses across different countries and
cultures.

Key trends shaping the trajectory of Elderly Companion Services include:
* **Technological Integration**: The use of devices like smart home technology and telehealth
  services to improve care delivery.
* **Policy Development**: Governments are increasingly developing policies that support elderly
  companionship, recognizing its importance in maintaining an aging population’s health and
  independence.
* **Market Expansion**: A growing number of private companies are entering the market, driven by
  both profit motives and a desire to fill gaps in public services.

**Economic Considerations**

The economic aspects of Elderly Companion Services are multifaceted. Market dynamics influence
service offerings and pricing, while investment patterns reflect the sector’s perceived value and
growth potential. These services contribute to economic systems by:
* **Reducing Healthcare Costs**: By providing preventative care and support, companion services can
  help reduce hospital readmission rates and healthcare costs.
* **Creating Employment Opportunities**: A rise in demand for these services has led to job
  creation, particularly in regions with aging populations.
* **Stimulating Innovation**: The need for specialized services drives technological innovation and
  the development of new care models.

**Technological Advancements**

Technology plays a critical role in enhancing Elderly Companion Services. From wearable devices that
monitor vital signs to AI-driven platforms that facilitate social engagement, advancements have
significantly improved service delivery. The impact of these technologies includes:
* **Increased Independence**: Smart home devices allow seniors to maintain their independence for
  longer by automating tasks and providing reminders for medications and appointments.
* **Improved Safety**: GPS-enabled wearables and fall detection systems can alert caregivers or
  emergency services in case of an accident, ensuring timely assistance.
* **Enhanced Engagement**: Virtual reality and other interactive technologies offer immersive
  experiences that can combat cognitive decline and improve mental health.

* **Workforce Shortages**: A lack of trained professionals can lead to service gaps, particularly in

To illustrate the impact of Elderly Companion Services, let’s consider two case studies:
1. **Rural Community Implementation**: A rural community introduced a program that utilized local

   significantly reduced feelings of isolation among seniors and provided them with a sense of
   belonging within their community.
2. **Urban Innovation Hub**: An urban area developed a technology-driven companion service platform
   that connected seniors with caregivers and health professionals through an app. This innovative

Elderly Companion Services are a critical component of eldercare in an aging world. They offer a
blend of social support, personal care assistance, and technological innovation that can improve the
quality of life for seniors while addressing economic, policy, and workforce challenges. As
societies globally grapple with the realities of an aging population, the role of companion services
will only grow in importance, making it essential to address current and emerging challenges
head-on.

**Looking Ahead**

The future of Elderly Companion Services is one of promise and potential. With a focus on
innovation, interdisciplinary collaboration, and policy reform, these services can continue to
evolve and meet the needs of an aging population. The key to success lies in the ability to adapt to
changing demographics, technological advancements, and societal values, ensuring that seniors
receive the care and companionship they deserve.

In a world where the population is aging at an unprecedented rate, the need for services that
support the elderly has become increasingly significant. Elderly Companion Services stand at the
forefront of this demand, offering a blend of companionship and assistance to enhance the quality of
life for seniors. This article delves into the multifaceted nature of these services, exploring
their impact, economic considerations, technological advancements, and the challenges they face. By
the end of this exploration, readers will have a nuanced understanding of Elderly Companion Services
and their pivotal role in society.

**Understanding Elderly Companion Services**

Elderly Companion Services are designed to provide companionship, emotional support, and various
forms of assistance to elderly individuals who may live alone or require aid due to physical or
cognitive limitations. These services range from daily activities like meal preparation and
medication management to providing a friendly presence that can reduce feelings of isolation and
loneliness. The core components of these services include:
* **Personal Care Assistance**: Help with bathing, dressing, toileting, and other personal care
  tasks.
* **Social Engagement**: Facilitating interactions with others to prevent social isolation.
* **Health Monitoring**: Keeping an eye on the client’s health and alerting family or medical
  professionals if necessary.
* **Homemaking Services**: Assisting with household chores such as cleaning, laundry, and meal
  preparation.

The historical context of Elderly Companion Services shows a gradual evolution from informal care
provided by family members to a more structured and professionalized service sector. As society
grapples with the realities of an aging population, these services have become an integral part of
the continuum of eldercare.

**Global Impact and Trends**

The impact of Elderly Companion Services is not confined to any single region but is a global
concern. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), the proportion of the world’s population
over 60 years will double from 12% in 2015 to 22% in 2050. This demographic shift has led to a rise
in demand for companion services worldwide, with varying responses across different countries and
cultures.

Key trends shaping the trajectory of Elderly Companion Services include:
* **Technological Integration**: The use of devices like smart home technology and telehealth
  services to improve care delivery.
* **Policy Development**: Governments are increasingly developing policies that support elderly
  companionship, recognizing its importance in maintaining an aging population’s health and
  independence.
* **Market Expansion**: A growing number of private companies are entering the market, driven by
  both profit motives and a desire to fill gaps in public services.

**Economic Considerations**

The economic aspects of Elderly Companion Services are multifaceted. Market dynamics influence
service offerings and pricing, while investment patterns reflect the sector’s perceived value and
growth potential. These services contribute to economic systems by:
* **Reducing Healthcare Costs**: By providing preventative care and support, companion services can
  help reduce hospital readmission rates and healthcare costs.
* **Creating Employment Opportunities**: A rise in demand for these services has led to job
  creation, particularly in regions with aging populations.
* **Stimulating Innovation**: The need for specialized services drives technological innovation and
  the development of new care models.

**Technological Advancements**

Technology plays a critical role in enhancing Elderly Companion Services. From wearable devices that
monitor vital signs to AI-driven platforms that facilitate social engagement, advancements have
significantly improved service delivery. The impact of these technologies includes:
* **Increased Independence**: Smart home devices allow seniors to maintain their independence for
  longer by automating tasks and providing reminders for medications and appointments.
* **Improved Safety**: GPS-enabled wearables and fall detection systems can alert caregivers or
  emergency services in case of an accident, ensuring timely assistance.
* **Enhanced Engagement**: Virtual reality and other interactive technologies offer immersive
  experiences that can combat cognitive decline and improve mental health.

**Policy and Regulation**

The landscape of Elderly Companion Services is governed by a complex array of policies, regulations,
and legislative frameworks. These are designed to protect the rights and welfare of seniors while
ensuring the quality and integrity of companion services. Key considerations include:
* **Privacy and Data Security**: As technology becomes more integrated into care delivery,
  protecting personal data and privacy becomes paramount.
* **Quality Standards**: Regulations that set benchmarks for service quality ensure that all seniors
  receive a standard of care that meets their needs.
* **Training and Certification**: Mandatory training and certification for providers help maintain
  high standards of care and professionalism.

**Challenges and Criticisms**

Despite their numerous benefits, Elderly Companion Services face several challenges and criticisms.
These include:
* **Workforce Shortages**: A lack of trained professionals can lead to service gaps, particularly in
  underserved areas.
* **Affordability and Accessibility**: High costs and limited availability can prevent many seniors
  from accessing these services.
* **Quality of Care Concerns**: Ensuring consistent and high-quality care is a persistent challenge
  for the industry.

**Case Studies**

To illustrate the impact of Elderly Companion Services, let’s consider two case studies:
1. **Rural Community Implementation**: A rural community introduced a program that utilized local
   volunteers trained to provide companionship and basic care services. This initiative
   significantly reduced feelings of isolation among seniors and provided them with a sense of
   belonging within their community.
2. **Urban Innovation Hub**: An urban area developed a technology-driven companion service platform
   that connected seniors with caregivers and health professionals through an app. This innovative
   approach improved response times, coordination of care, and overall satisfaction among users.

**Conclusion**

Elderly Companion Services are a critical component of eldercare in an aging world. They offer a
blend of social support, personal care assistance, and technological innovation that can improve the
quality of life for seniors while addressing economic, policy, and workforce challenges. As
societies globally grapple with the realities of an aging population, the role of companion services
will only grow in importance, making it essential to address current and emerging challenges
head-on.

**Looking Ahead**

The future of Elderly Companion Services is one of promise and potential. With a focus on
innovation, interdisciplinary collaboration, and policy reform, these services can continue to
evolve and meet the needs of an aging population. The key to success lies in the ability to adapt to
changing demographics, technological advancements, and societal values, ensuring that seniors
receive the care and companionship they deserve.

Founded in early 2011, Examine's mission is to analyze the full body of evidence to help you be
healthier. As an educational organization, we are not affiliated with any supplement or food
company, and our research team is contractually obligated to have no conflicts of interest.

Learn more: [About Examine][13] | [About our research process][14]

companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

# You’re Unique. So Is Your Weight Loss.

Losing weight isn’t always straightforward. Finding what works, staying motivated, and seeing real
progress can feel like an uphill battle. 

We get it. That’s why fatsecret offers tools and support tailored to your needs, wherever you are on
your weight loss journey.

[Get Started][41]
lose weight with fatsecret

## Your Weight Loss, Your Way

Weight loss works best when the tools you use match your needs. For some, that means tracking food
to better understand their eating habits. For others, it means having extra support, like meal
plans, education, and features that help you stay consistent. fatsecret gives you the flexibility to
manage things on your own, or go further with extra features designed to help you stay consistent
and make steady progress.

## Weight Loss FAQs

Find answers to commonly asked questions about our weight loss offerings.

What is the story behind fatsecret?

fatsecret was founded in 2006 and has been helping people achieve their weight loss goals for over
18 years. Our mission is to empower anyone to reach their desired weight through individualized and
sustainable weight loss. We envision a world where everyone achieves their desired weight, leading
to better health and happiness. The fatsecret app has grown to be one of the most trusted calorie
counting apps in the world. In recent years, we’ve expanded to offer even more support through the
fatsecret Clinic, providing access to GPs and Accredited Practicing Dietitian’s to help Australians
lose weight sustainably.

Who is fatsecret suitable for?

fatsecret is ideal for anyone on a health and weight loss journey, whether you’re just starting out
or have been working toward your goals for a while. The app provides essential tools to track food,
calories, and macros for free, supporting healthy habits at every stage. For those seeking more
comprehensive support, our Weight Loss Clinic offers medically supervised weight loss treatments and
personalised nutrition care, guided by qualified health professionals.

How much does fatsecret cost?

The fatsecret app and its core features are completely free to use. This includes calorie and macro
tracking backed by the worlds largest food and nutrition database, weight logging, the barcode
scanner, and access to our community. If you’re looking for more tools and support, fatsecret
Premium is available as a paid upgrade in the app and includes additional features like
Dietitian-designed Meal Plans, advanced tracking tools, the water tracker, Learning Center and more.
Pricing for Premium and availability of some features may vary by region and can be viewed directly
in the app.

Can I use fatsecret without trying to lose weight?

Yes. While many people use fatsecret to support weight loss, the app can also help you maintain your
current weight, build healthier habits, or simply become more aware of your eating patterns.
However, the fatsecret app is designed to support weight loss, so if you are not trying to lose
weight, some content may not feel as relevant to you.

# Welcome to Heart to Heart

**30 accumulated years** in the healthcare industry. Heart To Heart provides a wide spectrum of
health and social services throughout NY, including home care, behavioral health and a wide variety
of related services to individuals of all ages within the community.

[See New York Locations][24]

## Our Health Programs

Since 2006, Heart To Heart has provided Home Health Aide and Personal Care Aide services through
contracts with most of the Certified Home Health Agencies (CHHAs) and Long Term Home Health Care
Programs (LTHHCPs) in New York.

Heart To Heart flagship division of Home Care has Accreditation with Commendation from the Joint
Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations.

### In Home Care

Home care enables you to have the peace of mind that your loved one is getting taken care in the
comfort of their own home.

### day programs

Heart to Heart provides day habilitation programs for individuals with I/DD.

[heart icon]

### NHTD

NHTD is a type of Home Care paid for by Medicaid. It allows eligible New Yorkers to choose, hire,
and supervise their own home care aides.

### Behavioral Health

Our behavioral support services promote behavioral support for individuals and their families
through behavior support plans.

### Residential Group Homes

Our group homes offer round-the-block care for individuals in the community providing a safe and
healthy environment to enhance quality of life.

### Support Services

Heart to Heart’s 24/7 around-the-clock care provides a sense of security and safety to our clients
and their families.

# Welcome to Heart to Heart

of related services to individuals of all ages within the community.

## Our Health Programs

Since 2006, Heart To Heart has provided Home Health Aide and Personal Care Aide services through
contracts with most of the Certified Home Health Agencies (CHHAs) and Long Term Home Health Care
Programs (LTHHCPs) in New York.

Heart To Heart flagship division of Home Care has Accreditation with Commendation from the Joint
Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations.

### In Home Care

Home care enables you to have the peace of mind that your loved one is getting taken care in the
comfort of their own home.

### day programs

Heart to Heart provides day habilitation programs for individuals with I/DD.

[heart icon]

### NHTD

NHTD is a type of Home Care paid for by Medicaid. It allows eligible New Yorkers to choose, hire,
and supervise their own home care aides.

### Behavioral Health

Our behavioral support services promote behavioral support for individuals and their families
through behavior support plans.

### Residential Group Homes

Our group homes offer round-the-block care for individuals in the community providing a safe and
healthy environment to enhance quality of life.

### Support Services

Heart to Heart’s 24/7 around-the-clock care provides a sense of security and safety to our clients
and their families.

## Most clinics give you 15 minutes. **We give you answers.**** **

#### Need answers after hours?

Get trusted advice from Dr. Lewis (or another available veterinary expert) anytime—just click the
[JustAnswer – for questions after hours][44] link in the Client Corner dropdown menu. We’re not here
to rush your pet through another vaccine visit. As a family-owned veterinary practice, we’re here to
solve problems, catch things early, and give you real answers—without the wait, the vagueness, or
impersonal care.

You’ve got questions. We’ve got time. Let’s get it right.
**** **** **** **
**

## 0+ Questions Answered on

[
Request an AppointmentRequest an Appointment
][45]
[JustAnswer.com][46] You’ve seen his advice online. Now, you get the full exam room version.

With over 25,000 questions answered on [JustAnswer.com][47], Dr. Lewis has spent more than a decade
helping pet owners make sense of confusing symptoms, late-night emergencies, and big decisions about
their animal’s care.

Now? He’s doing the same thing for Huntington Beach…just with more exam rooms and fewer screens. **
**

## This Isn’t High-Volume Medicine. It’s **high-Attention Medicine.**

** Most clinics are overwhelmed. Too many patients. Not enough time. No space to think, let alone
explain.

That’s not how we work. We keep our caseload manageable so we can go deeper: asking the right
questions, doing real diagnostics, and making sure nothing gets missed.

We don’t skip steps—and we don’t send you home wondering what just happened. This is modern
medicine, with follow-through baked in. **** **** **** ****
****

# Veterinary care for **Huntington Beach, Fountain Valley, Costa Mesa, and beyond**

** We’re here for pet owners who want more than the basics. More than vague answers. More than
reactive care.

Whether it’s a wellness visit, a chronic skin issue, or something that just doesn’t feel right—we’ll
take it seriously. We serve Huntington Beach and the surrounding communities, but most of all, we
serve pet people who want to do things right.

If that sounds like you, let’s get you on the schedule.
[
Request an AppointmentRequest an Appointment
][48]

Join IntechOpen in its mission to publish the best scientific research and increase the visibility of your work. [Learn More][61] ### Author in the Centre Built by scientists, for scientists. We provide a unique personal approach, day-to-day support, and all the tools you need to make your work accessible worldwide. ### Peer-review Our robust peer review ensures your work is suitable for publication and valuable to the scientific community. ### Online First On acceptance of your work, our early online publication provides access to the scientific community without delay. ### Open Access Your work will be permanently available online, free to download, share and read. ## 11,600+ Research Institutions Support Open Access at IntechOpen [View All Institutions][62] [[City University Of Hong Kong]][63] [[Iowa State University]][64] [[Fudan University]][65] [[Kings College]][66] [[Peking University]][67] [[Seoul]][68] [[Tsinghua University]][69] [[UMass Amherst]][70] [[Universidadde Buenos Aires]][71] [[Universidad Rey Juan Carlosde]][72] [[Universitatde Barcelona]][73] [[Universitéde Strasbourg]][74] [[University of Kansas]][75] [[CSIC]][76] [[University of Surrey]][77] 06 May 2026 ##### Reaching New Heights: IntechOpen Publishes its 8,000th Open Access Book IntechOpen is proud to announce a significant milestone for 2026: the publication of our 8,000th open access book. This milestone comes shortly after the 20th anniversary of the publication of our first OA book. [Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. This milestone reflects not only the company’s achievements but also the growing recognition of open access books as a vital model for academic publishing, contributing to the transformation of how knowledge is shared worldwide. [Read more][79] 16 October 2025 ##### IntechOpen Among First Publishers to Go Live with OA Switchboard Books Solution We are proud to announce that IntechOpen is among the first three publishers, alongside Cambridge University Press and University of Michigan Press, to go live with the OA Switchboard Books Solution. [Read more][80] 23 April 2025 ##### IntechOpen Marked 7,500th OA Book Release with 'Climate Policies,' Co-edited by Members of ##### Nobel Peace Prize-Winning IPCC Team Co-edited by Gary Yohe and Joel Smith, senior members of the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize-winning Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), this timely volume offers a comprehensive evaluation of contemporary climate policy strategies. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. ## Q&A

### Is MyFitnessPal a free calorie tracker app?

Yes! If you're looking for a free calorie counter app, you're in the right place. Simply [sign up
for your free account][6] here and start tracking your food.

The MyFitnessPal app does a lot more than track calories in foods. You can also track macros,
vitamins, and other micronutrients and see how everything you eat supports your goals.

**Want to level up your goals? Upgrade to Premium!** Unlock MyFitnessPal's best tools (like Barcode
Scan, Intermittent Fasting, and Custom Macro Goals).

If you've never upgraded to MyFitnessPal Premium or never started a Premium trial before, you are
eligible for a 7-day free trial. [Start your free trial now.][7]

The first Premium subscription charge on your credit card will be after the trial. Once the trial
ends, your subscription will auto-renew unless you cancel. If you purchased a monthly subscription,
you will be charged every month. If you purchased an annual subscription, you will be charged every
year.

You may cancel your recurring subscription at any time. Cancel at least 24 hours before the next
renewal date to avoid being charged for the upcoming billing cycle. When you cancel, you are
canceling the next billing charge—Premium features will remain available to you until the end of
your current paid subscription period, regardless of when you cancel the automatic renewal.

### How to track calories with a calorie counter app like MyFitnessPal?

If you want to know how many calories are in the foods you eat, or how many calories you eat each
day, the MyFitnessPal app makes it easy.

[Sign up for a free account][8] and download the app. Then you can quickly look up calories and
nutrients for any food AND track it all to see the impact of food on your health and fitness goals.

Free members can do a simple food search from their app's home screen. Premium members have access
to other time-saving tools that allow you to scan a barcode or individual foods with your phone's
camera to instantly identify the best match. [Learn more about Premium and try it free][9].

However you choose to look up calories for foods, MyFitnessPal gives you access to over 18 million
global foods in one of the world's largest food databases — including fresh foods, packaged goods,
restaurant items, and even foods and recipes you save yourself.

### What nutrition data can I track besides calories?

MyFitnessPal isn't just a calorie tracking app. We're a macro tracking app, a micronutrient tracking
app, and a water tracking app — all in one! (Not to mention the other goals you can track, including
weight, exercise, steps, and intermittent fasting.)

Simply log the foods you eat using one of our easy food tracking tools, and we'll show you a
complete nutritional breakdown for each food, meal, day, and even week. Any way you want to look at
your data, you'll gain a better understanding of your personal nutrition so you can make smart
choices that align with your weight, health, and fitness goals.

### Does MyFitnessPal use a BMI calculator or BMR calculator to set goals?

Yes, MyFitnessPal uses a BMR calculator to help you set calorie goals. During signup, you'll be
asked questions about your height, weight, age, and sex to estimate your BMR (basal metabolic rate).

account your typical activity level during the day to calculate your daily calorie needs. Depending
on your weight goals, we either add or subtract calories from your daily calorie needs (500 calories
per pound of weight change per week desired).

of your weight to your height, and we don't allow you to set weight goals below a certain ratio.

other equations, being able to get within 10% of your actual energy needs on average.

tracking.

## **The NNV Way**

At Nina’s Nutritional Values, we specialize in helping adults—especially busy women over 40—prevent
and manage chronic conditions like **high blood pressure**, **diabetes**, and **high cholesterol**
through food-first, evidence-based strategies. We guide you in achieving sustainable weight loss and
better health without restrictive diets or cutting out the foods you love.

[ Discover how ][30]

## **Ditch the diets. Keep the flavor.**

Say goodbye to the frustrating cycle of yo-yo dieting and hello to a sustainable, energizing way of
living. This isn’t another short-term fix—it’s a real-life, real-food approach that actually sticks.
Together, we’ll make your transformation feel less like punishment and more like empowerment. Ready
to feel good, eat well, and live vibrantly?

### **About NNV Founder Nina G. Hall, PhD, RDN, LD**

## **Feel Better, Live Lighter, Love Your Plate!**
* ## Balance Over Restriction
  
  We believe in nourishing the body without extremes. Our approach helps you reach your health goals
  without cutting out the foods you love.
* ## Empathy and Respect
  
  You are more than a number or lab result. We listen, meet you where you are, and create a safe
  space for real, judgment-free support.
* ## Science-Backed, Real-Life Solutions
  
  Every recommendation is rooted in evidence-based nutrition—not trends. We translate science into
  practical, sustainable strategies that fit your everyday life.
* ## Empowerment Through Education
  
  We don’t just tell you what to do—we help you understand why it matters. When you’re informed,
  you’re empowered to make lasting change.
* ## Sustainable Progress
  
  Health isn’t a race—it’s a lifelong journey. We focus on realistic goals, steady growth, and
  building habits that stick.
* ## Collaboration and Customization
  
  Your nutrition path is uniquely yours. We work with you—not on you—to create personalized plans
  that align with your goals, culture, preferences, and schedule.
* ## Whole-Person Health
  
  True wellness goes beyond food. We consider your stress, sleep, activity, mindset, and life
  demands to support lasting, whole-body health.

  tailored to your health goals, preferences, and lifestyle. Whether you’re managing blood pressure,

## Nina’s Nutritional Values Blog

incorporating more plant-based foods in your diet can transform your health, many vegan foods are
ultra-processed. A diet high in ultra-processed vegan foods or non-vegan foods raises your risk of
cardiovascular disease.

Even nutrient-dense foods such as fruit must be consumed in moderation. But let’s face it, when we
overeat, we’re often eating fried, high-fat, high-sugar, and ultra-processed foods. Here’s how to
curb overeating to improve your whole-body health.

diet. Some foods contain compounds that block the absorption of the cholesterol you consume. You can
also add foods to your diet that optimize liver function to remove cholesterol. This blog post has

## Comprehensive and accessible care services for the whole family

Building on more than four decades of experience and expertise, NTUC Health is among the largest
senior day care, nursing home and home personal care providers in Singapore.

We also offer other services for seniors such as fitness classes and senior gyms, and community
support for vulnerable seniors. In addition, we run a family medicine clinic.

[home-elderly-care.jpg]

### Elderly Care

Enjoy peace of mind when you entrust us with the care of your loved ones. We provide different care
services from centre-based and home care, to temporary respite care and 24/7 residential care.

[
LEARN MORE
][28]

### Active Ageing

Stay active in your senior years. Join our strength training fitness programmes and free health
talks where you can pick up new skills and make friends with like-minded people. There's never a
dull moment at our Active Ageing Centres!

[
LEARN MORE
][29]
[home-active-ageing.jpg]
[physio-rehab-flipped.jpg]

### Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation

Maintain your strength and get on the road to recovery with our physiotherapy, occupational therapy
and speech therapy services available at more than 20 locations islandwide. For added convenience,
opt for home or tele-rehabilitation.

[
LEARN MORE
][30]

### Family Medicine

Manage chronic illnesses such as diabetes and high blood pressure with a team of family physicians
and healthcare professionals at our Family Medicine Clinic. Consultation for acute conditions such
as upper respiratory tract infections, and preventive care such as vaccinations and health screening
are also available.

[
LEARN MORE
][31]
[home-fmc.jpg]
[Elevated-West-view.jpg]

### Our Locations

Our elderly care and active ageing services are conveniently located in a neighbourhood near you.

[
LEARN MORE
][32]
Be Ageless with NTUC Health

By living with purpose and passion regardless of your age!

[
LEARN MORE

## Comprehensive and accessible care services for the whole family

Building on more than four decades of experience and expertise, NTUC Health is among the largest
senior day care, nursing home and home personal care providers in Singapore.

We also offer other services for seniors such as fitness classes and senior gyms, and community
support for vulnerable seniors. In addition, we run a family medicine clinic.

[home-elderly-care.jpg]

### Elderly Care

Enjoy peace of mind when you entrust us with the care of your loved ones. We provide different care
services from centre-based and home care, to temporary respite care and 24/7 residential care.

[
LEARN MORE
][28]

### Active Ageing

Stay active in your senior years. Join our strength training fitness programmes and free health
talks where you can pick up new skills and make friends with like-minded people. There's never a
dull moment at our Active Ageing Centres!

[
LEARN MORE
][29]
[home-active-ageing.jpg]
[physio-rehab-flipped.jpg]

### Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation

Maintain your strength and get on the road to recovery with our physiotherapy, occupational therapy
and speech therapy services available at more than 20 locations islandwide. For added convenience,
opt for home or tele-rehabilitation.

[
LEARN MORE
][30]

### Family Medicine

Manage chronic illnesses such as diabetes and high blood pressure with a team of family physicians
and healthcare professionals at our Family Medicine Clinic. Consultation for acute conditions such
as upper respiratory tract infections, and preventive care such as vaccinations and health screening
are also available.

[
LEARN MORE
][31]
[home-fmc.jpg]
[Elevated-West-view.jpg]

### Our Locations

Our elderly care and active ageing services are conveniently located in a neighbourhood near you.

[
LEARN MORE
][32]

By living with purpose and passion regardless of your age!

## Our Story

From humble beginnings to a global sports nutrition leader.

Founded in 1986, Optimum Nutrition was created with one mission: to deliver consistent, trusted, and
effective nutrition that helps people of all fitness levels reach their goals with confidence.

From our world-renowned Gold Standard 100% Whey to our cutting-edge pre-workouts and supplements, we
continue to lead the way in quality, innovation, and performance worldwide.

## Our Core Values

Driven by science. Trusted by athletes. Built for performance.

### Proven Quality

Every ON product is tested for purity, potency, and consistency to meet the highest global standards
in sports nutrition.

### Science-Based Innovation

We combine leading nutritional science with advanced manufacturing techniques to deliver products
powered by results.

### Commitment to Excellence

From the ingredients we source to the athletes who trust us, excellence defines every stage of our
journey.

## Our Journey

Decades of dedication and performance.

1986

#### Brand Foundation

Optimum Nutrition was founded with the goal of giving athletes access to the highest-quality protein
and sports nutrition available anywhere.

2004

#### The Gold Standard Era

Launch of Gold Standard 100% Whey Protein, which quickly became the most recognized and trusted
protein powder in the world.

2025

#### A Future of Sustainable Performance

ON introduces eco-conscious packaging and continues advancing nutrition through clean, effective
formulas that respect both health and the planet.

## Classic Products

### Gold Standard 100% Whey

The world’s best-selling whey protein powder, offering 24g of premium protein per serving to support
muscle recovery and growth. Trusted by athletes around the world for its taste, quality, and proven
results.

### Serious Mass

A powerhouse gainer formula designed to help you build strength and mass the right way. Packed with
calories, protein, and essential nutrients, Serious Mass supports intense training and performance
goals.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers about product use, safety, and nutrition tips.

01

### Are Optimum Nutrition products tested for quality?

Yes. All ON products are produced in GMP-certified facilities and undergo rigorous testing for
safety, purity, and potency.

02

### When should I take whey protein?

Whey protein can be taken post-workout for muscle recovery or anytime during the day to help meet
your daily protein needs.

03

### Is Serious Mass suitable for beginners?

Yes. Serious Mass is perfect for those aiming to gain healthy weight or increase calorie intake
alongside strength training.

04

### Where can I buy genuine ON products?

Visit the official website or authorized online and retail partners to ensure authenticity and
product quality.

## Why Choose Us?

[PrimeCarers Logo][PrimeCarers Logo]

### Find The Right Carer For You

We've already vetted all caregivers on the platform so you can focus on finding the perfect match
for you or your loved ones.

[PrimeCarers Logo][PrimeCarers Logo]

### You Pay Less, They Earn More

We directly connect Carers and families, charging the lowest fees in the industry. That means carers
are getting what they deserve and you're paying less.

[PrimeCarers Logo][PrimeCarers Logo]

### Let Us Handle The Admin

Our team takes all the hassle out of paying for and managing care. Book your appointments online and
we'll handle the rest. Let us do the work for you.

[photo Racheal A][photo Racheal A]

The Checks

## How Do We Check
## Private Carers?

### Full ID Check

A Full ID check including right to work in the UK. We use a government approved service called Yoti
to verify carer ID applications online.

### Enhanced DBS Certificate

We ask that all our carers have an enhanced DBS certificate on the update service. We regularly
check carers certificates against the update service for any new items.

### Professional Interview

We interview all our carers to test their technical knowledge and to evaluate their compassion and
mannerisms.

Find out more about what makes [the best carers here.][4]

The Process

## How Does It Work?

[PrimeCarers Logo][PrimeCarers Logo]

Search for local carers

Search for caregivers near you with the skills you need. We have a range of carers available, from
home helpers to experienced nurses.

[PrimeCarers Logo][PrimeCarers Logo]

Connect over chat

Reach out to your favourite private carers, tell them what you need and get to know them.

[PrimeCarers Logo][PrimeCarers Logo]

Book an Interview

Meet with them in person (or via video chat) for a no-obligation interview, so you can decide if
they're right for you.

[PrimeCarers Logo][PrimeCarers Logo]

Manage Your Care

We'll handle all the admin, including contracting, payroll, insurance and continuous background
checks. All you have to do is book your visits.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions? We're here to help.

What is PrimeCarers?

PrimeCarers is an online platform that connects individuals who require care and support with
professional and experienced carers and personal assistants, who are often more cost-effective than
agency carers. They are also vetted by PrimeCarers, ensuring a safe and reliable working
relationship. Our platform provides a hassle-free and efficient way to find and hire compassionate
carers who offer person-centred care tailored to your unique needs. To get started, you can easily
search for carers in your area and contact them directly. Our advanced matching algorithm will also
suggest potential matches based on your preferences, and we will share your requirements with them
so they can get in touch with you. From there, you can communicate with them, assess their
suitability, and eventually hire the best carer for your needs. Our platform offers a simple and
effective solution to finding the right carer for you.

Should I meet a carer or personal assistant before approving a service agreement on PrimeCarers?

While most people choose to have phone calls and video calls with their carers before beginning work
with them, and may have a trial period of a few days to a couple of weeks, we offer you the ability
to book in-person interviews. This allows you to get to know the carer better and ensure that they
are the right fit for your needs.

What happens if I am not satisfied with my carer or personal assistant on PrimeCarers?

If you are not satisfied with your carer or personal assistant on PrimeCarers, please let us know as
soon as possible. We will work with you to resolve any issues and find a replacement if necessary.

What are the advantages of domiciliary/homecare over care homes?

Homecare provides the opportunity for individuals to remain in the comfort of their own home while
receiving personalised care and support. This can lead to a better quality of life, greater
independence, and increased feelings of security and familiarity. Homecare can also be more
affordable and less disruptive to daily routines than care homes. Additionally, individuals with
memory issues may experience significant worsening of their symptoms if they are taken out of their
home environment. Homecare can provide a familiar and comfortable setting that can help to mitigate
these issues.

Which areas of the UK does PrimeCarers cover?

PrimeCarers covers all areas of the UK, including major cities and rural areas.

How does PrimeCarers work?

PrimeCarers is an innovative online platform that connects clients with qualified and experienced
carers, care workers, and personal assistants. Here's how to get started:
1. Pop in your postcode to find carers, pick the one you like the most and hit the contact button.
2. Tell us about your situation, the patient, and what you need help with by contacting a carer.
3. Our AI Matchmaker will then post your job and find the carers that are best suited for you.
4. You can then accept or reject the carers and engage with the one you like the most on PrimeCarers
   or over the phone.
5. Once you have chosen your carer(s), you can easily book visits on the platform and PrimeCarers
   will take care of all administrative tasks for you.

Can I hire multiple carers or personal assistants at the same time on PrimeCarers?

Yes, you can hire multiple carers or personal assistants at the same time on PrimeCarers, depending
on your individual needs and requirements.

What is care?

Domiciliary care, also known as home care, refers to the provision of care and support services that
are provided in an individual's own home. This type of care can be broken down into several
categories, including hourly care, live-in care, and respite care.
* Live-in care involves carers living with individuals in their own homes and providing continuous
  support and care. This type of care is ideal for individuals who require more intensive support,
  such as those with complex medical conditions, disabilities, or dementia.
* Hourly care involves carers visiting individuals in their own homes for a set amount of time each
  day or week to provide support with daily activities, such as dressing, washing, meal preparation,
  and medication management. This type of care is ideal for individuals who require support to
  maintain their independence but do not require around-the-clock care.
* Respite care involves providing temporary care and support to individuals who usually receive care
  from a family member or regular carer. This type of care allows the primary caregiver to take a
  break and recharge, while ensuring that their loved one is still receiving the care and support
  they need.

In all cases, domiciliary care services are designed to support individuals to live independently in
their own homes for as long as possible, while also improving their quality of life and promoting
their overall wellbeing.

  convey your needs.

  level of care.

anything goes wrong, we are there to provide support and help resolve any issues that may arise.
